title: Meiji · Taishô · Shôwa: Ryôki onna hanzai-shi
actors: Sada Abe, Takashi Fujiki, Shôtarô Hayashi
plot: Discover 4 famous Japanese murderers: Takahashi Oden, the last woman beheaded in Japan, Sada Abe, a crazy lover, Kunihiko Kodaira, a rapist-killer and finally, the Toyokaku case, a woman who did everything to own a hotel.
